title: AdaptiveResidencyController (replay prototype) and ablations
closure: CLOSED 2026-10-11 under frozen protocol EXP010-P1a: both models STATIC_BETTER_OR_EQUAL vs the DEV-fitted workload-family-informed static comparator; verdict applies to the surviving retrospective-holdout sub-question only

protocol.amendment_scope: Pre-execution terminology and validation hardening only; no scientific decision rule changed and no EXP-010 DEV/EVAL replay or result was computed under P1.
protocol.leakage_classification: B - RETROSPECTIVE HOLDOUT (EVAL traces and adaptive candidate outcomes inspected during EXP-007; not a preregistration)
protocol.surviving_subquestion: Does a controller configuration selected using DEV only keep an advantage over static allocation when applied unchanged to EVAL?
protocol.dev_objective: G_DEV = geometric mean over 21 equal-weight DEV cells (7 workloads x 3 budgets) of misses(candidate) / misses(per-layer-lru-uniform); lowest wins; tie-break |dG| < 1e-4 -> fewer bytes moved -> larger epoch -> no pinning
protocol.primary_eval_comparison: DEV-selected adaptive vs DEV-fitted, workload-family-informed static allocation (layer-aware-static, compare --train DEV) applied unchanged to EVAL
protocol.closure_rule: EXP010-CR1-directional (no effect-size threshold): per model ADAPTIVE_BETTER if G_pool < 1 and W > 10.5 and G_uniform <= 1; STATIC_BETTER_OR_EQUAL if G_pool >= 1 and W <= 10.5; else MIXED. SUPPORTED if both ADAPTIVE_BETTER; FALSIFIED if both STATIC_BETTER_OR_EQUAL or G_uniform > 1 in both; else INCONCLUSIVE

result.applies_to: surviving retrospective-holdout sub-question (DEV-selected adaptive vs DEV-fitted workload-family-informed static on EVAL); not layer-aware allocation, not the central RQ; 'approach the oracle' has no verdict
